intro: As young tauren prepare to depart their ancestral training grounds on Red Cloud Mesa, Chief Hawkwind asks them to perform a final favor. He entrusts them with a bundle of essential supplies meant for Kaga Wildhoof, a seasoned wanderer camped near Bloodhoof Village who once aided the chief in his own past.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Wait, friend. I have another ask of you, before you leave us.

There is an adventurer by the name of Kaga Wildhoof who has made camp just outside of Bloodhoof Village. She has greatly helped me in the past, and now I see my chance to repay her. Could you deliver these supplies to her?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Chief Hawkwind sent you? I told him back then I needed no compensation, but it seems he hasn't listened. Thank you, adventurer.
Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
